problem_text:
A city planner needs to distribute a fixed budget across 14 infrastructure projects to maximize the total projected benefit score.  
The characteristics of each project are as follows:  
* Project A: benefit score 0.181, resource requirement 0.095, allocation limits [0.100, 0.565]  
* Project B: benefit score 0.059, resource requirement 0.202, allocation limits [0.026, 0.455]  
* Project C: benefit score 0.128, resource requirement 0.032, allocation limits [0.081, 0.321]  
* Project D: benefit score 0.042, resource requirement 0.141, allocation limits [0.018, 0.342]  
* Project E: benefit score 0.192, resource requirement 0.299, allocation limits [0.007, 0.737]  
* Project F: benefit score 0.036, resource requirement 0.233, allocation limits [0.098, 0.766]  
* Project G: benefit score 0.129, resource requirement 0.211, allocation limits [0.020, 0.311]  
* Project H: benefit score 0.088, resource requirement 0.204, allocation limits [0.039, 0.599]  
* Project I: benefit score 0.157, resource requirement 0.233, allocation limits [0.065, 0.692]  
* Project J: benefit score 0.137, resource requirement 0.085, allocation limits [0.011, 0.301]  
* Project K: benefit score 0.165, resource requirement 0.236, allocation limits [0.054, 0.323]  
* Project L: benefit score 0.053, resource requirement 0.090, allocation limits [0.043, 0.534]  
* Project M: benefit score 0.040, resource requirement 0.028, allocation limits [0.061, 0.391]  
* Project N: benefit score 0.053, resource requirement 0.123, allocation limits [0.011, 0.498]  

Each project must receive a fraction of the total budget within its specified allocation limits, and all fractions must sum to one.  
To ensure timely completion, the set of high-priority projects L = {A, B, C, E, F, G, K, L, N} must together receive at least 0.541 of the total budget.  
Additionally, the total resource requirement across all projects must not exceed 0.207, and the total benefit score must be at least 0.074.  
Determine the optimal budget allocation that maximizes the total benefit score while satisfying all constraints.
